name: Socket Smile
description: A small smile gives the familiar dots a warmer expression.
prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Edit the supplied Socket logo into ONE more charming relatable expression for Fabrica, an industrial software tools brand. Keep the CLOSED hexagonal cube outline, top and bottom points, vertical sidewalls, weight, proportions and large black interior. Gently round the six vertices just a little so it feels crafted and approachable, not sharp or padded. Only change the interior facial expression as described. Strict flat WHITE #ffffff artwork on a solid pure BLACK #000000 square background. No texture, no gradient, no shadow, no checkerboard, no transparency, no text or presentation. Complete mark centered with generous 15 percent margins. This must work at 16px and 12px: very simple bold shapes, large black gaps around all facial elements, no tiny pupils, no eyelashes, no eyebrows, no nose, no cheek marks or extra details. Warm competent workshop companion, understated charm, not a spooky mask. SMILE: keep two simple round eyes but make each slightly smaller than in the reference and move their row slightly upward. Smile is gentle, not a huge grin; no teeth or tongue. Ensure a large vertical gap between eyes and smile and between smile and bottom outline. Total four white shapes: frame, two eyes, smile.
